fragments.text: Optical sensors can estimate blood oxygenation by measuring differences in light absorption at two wavelengths, commonly near 660 nm and 940 nm. The ratio of the pulsatile component follows from the Beer-Lambert relationship.
Pulse oximetry separates a pulsatile arterial signal from the steadier background of tissue and venous blood. Established practice uses this method for noninvasive spot checks.
Electric propulsion accelerates a propellant with electric and magnetic fields. Ion thrusters and Hall thrusters are established spacecraft methods. They trade higher specific impulse for low thrust.
Known challenges include power-supply mass, electrode erosion, and keeping the spacecraft electrically neutral.
Wearable monitors are small devices held against the body. Optical measurements and radio links are each established in consumer products, and reviewed notes here stay at that general level.

Specialized processors make AI inference more efficient by performing many arithmetic operations at once and by moving less data between memory and the processor. Quantization represents numbers with fewer bits, which reduces memory bandwidth. These techniques are established in public computer architecture.

A transistor in an integrated circuit acts as a small switch. Complementary pairs of switches draw little current while holding a value, which is the usual way public designs limit power. This description stays at that textbook level.
